tests.test_purpose: Primary/official/governing sources are preferred for material/current claims.
tests.input: Current legal, medical, financial, technical or product claim
tests.expected_result: Prefer governing primary/official source where suitable evidence exists.
tests.actual_result: Required source-hierarchy rule is present in both editions.
tests.evidence: Validator checks source-hierarchy tokens in Free/Go and Paid blocks.
tests.release_consequence: Fixes demonstrated source-rigor weakness at scenario level.

tests.test_purpose: Secondary sources do not become sole support when primary evidence exists.
tests.input: A convenient blog/summary conflicts with or substitutes for an available governing source.
tests.expected_result: Use secondary source for context/corroboration and prefer governing evidence.
tests.actual_result: Both editions explicitly encode this behavior.

tests.test_purpose: High-consequence/disputed claims receive extra verification and conflict handling.
tests.expected_result: Cross-check when practical and surface conflicts/limits.
tests.actual_result: Controls are present in both editions.
tests.evidence: Source-hierarchy clauses plus paid high-consequence rule.
